featured_reviews.name: Drashti Maniyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish I visited this place sooner. Honestly, one of the best cafes I have been to. The food is just top notch.
We had-
1. Hazelnut Chocolate Shake- perfectly made using dark chocolate. Great taste of hazelnuts as well.
2. Cheesecake smoothie- felt like a blueberry cheesecake but in a glass. So good!
3. Cottage Cheese Chimichurri Crepe- HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! The best dish I have had lately. It is very filling. The crepe was stuffed with vegetables in a green gravy along with paneer. Poured a nice cheese sauce over it. Quantity was good enough for 2.
4. Roast bell pepper pasta with onions, sundried tomatoes and cream cheese- The taste was spot on. Cream cheese added a nice taste. You will definitely lick your fingers after this one.
5. Hummus platter- Hummus was very smooth, served with bread, lavash, ragi crackers and salad. Hummus could be lil more garlicky and pita bread instead of normal bread would be ideal. Nevertheless, it was decent.
6. Baked lemon cheesecake- This was on my list for so long. The lemon cream had a nice zing and hit all the right notes. Please please try it out.
If you are looking to try something new and unique, this one is for you.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Staff - the staff looks a little lost and slow at speed. Nonetheless, they do their work efficiently.

Ambience-
The cafe has cozy corners, different seatings and provides ample space and light for it to not feel too crowded and stuffy. Nothing to complain about.

Food -
Jalapeño Lemonade - 1/5
More like Jaljeera. They took the longest time to serve this. it came when we were almost done with our meals. Complete disappointment. No spiceness, nothing. I don't even know why they bothered with that name.

Baked classic nachos - 5/5
ABSOLUTELY LOVED IT. loved the sauce, the spices, the size of nacho chips, the quantity. Loved everything about it. Would highly recommend it.

Spicy crudo - 4.5/5
The crust was amazing. It was tender, soft and easy to bite into without it being extremely chewy. Loved the cheese, the toppings were on point. It is underrated and needs more recognition.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chaayos doesn't needs any introduction when it comes to casual hangout place and This outlet never disappoint you in terms of Food taste and Extremely quick service.

We went there during weekend for quick bite and Loved almost everything we ordered for!

We tried below food options:

Kulhad Pav bhaji: This was served in the coolest possible way. Pav bhaji in kulhad topped with Generous amount of butter with Crispy buttery pav. Taste was really good and spices were balancing the overall taste and my palate were enjoying like anything.

Palak Patta chaat: This was the star of the day, Never ever tried Palak pakoda as crisp as this. It was topped with Chutney, curd, Masala, Onion and lot more. Every bite was completely worth the hype.

Kasundi Paneer: Freshness of bread were taking this dish to next level. It was stuffed with cheese, Paneer, creamy sauces and tons of flavours. Couldn't ask any better

Chaai: The best part was you can customise ur chai based on preference. I asked for full milk, badi elaichi, Tulsi, adrak and end result was divine.

Overall we were Extremely impressed with food and Would love to visit again, Especially for their Palak Patta chaat!!!!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Left feeling quite dissatisfied overall

I had high hopes for Gremy because the ambience is genuinely cute and the menu looks very promising, but unfortunately the food and drinks were a major letdown.

Iced Cappuccino (0/10) – As someone who loves coffee, this was the most disappointing item. It tasted extremely watery and lacked any real coffee flavor. Calling it a cappuccino felt like a stretch.

Strawberry Matcha (3/10) – It looked great when it arrived, but there was barely any matcha taste. Once mixed with the strawberry syrup, it tasted exactly like strawberry milk. The matcha quality seemed very poor, with none of the earthy, distinct flavor you’d expect.

Veg Tempura Sushi (2/10) – Surprisingly bad. There were hardly any vegetables in the filling. They seemed to use the same crispy bits inside the sushi as well with literally no veggies.It’s disappointing to see basic sushi done so poorly.

Chilli Lotus Stem (7/10) – The only item that was actually enjoyable. It was decent and saved the meal from being a complete disaster.

For a bill of around ₹1.7k , I expected much better quality. The ambience and presentation create a great first impression, but the food and beverages simply don’t live up to the expectations.
